references.role: Accepted creature concept basis: black segmented low centipede-like body, antennae, mandibles and stinging tail; not rocks or old rendering

gmReview.notes: Good concept, may use as basis.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single full-body portrait for a fictional tabletop game's Bestiary. Naturalistic HAND-PAINTED illustration, matching the supplied painting reference's grounded proportions, restrained brushwork and empty dark charcoal subtly painted backdrop. Soft neutral upper-left illumination, muted earthy palette, a small diffuse contact shadow only. Broad, calm light-to-shadow gradients on large surfaces; detail is selective at the face, silhouette and a few functional seams. Large folds and local damage rather than a uniform cracked-paint mesh or high-frequency surface noise. Entire subject, every foot, appendage, tool tip and tail comfortably inside a vertical 4:5 portrait with about 6% breathing room. No scenery, captions, letters, logos, frame, base disc or circular crop. A neutral standing/display pose, no combat scene, target, victim, blood or gore. Any style-only human reference supplies painting and lighting ONLY, never its person, clothes, weapons or anatomy.
Image 1 supplies the accepted KITCHIN CONCEPT, image 2 supplies painting and backdrop only. Redraw one small low crawling black-chitin centipede-like creature with a flexible segmented trunk, compact mandibled head, TWO thin antennae and a slender rear stinger. Use EXACTLY TWELVE walking legs, six paired sets distributed along the trunk, SIX on each side. The antennae, mandibles and rear stinger are not legs. Each pair attaches to a different body segment, no clumped pile of limbs at the head. Keep the body low, narrow and flexible enough to slip into a shoe; no bulky scorpion pincers, wings or generic six-legged beetle build. Slightly elevated three-quarter-front view, trunk in a shallow gentle arc so the separate leg pairs remain readable. Smooth broad dark carapace plates with restrained soft highlights and selected joints, rather than photographic pores everywhere. Entire creature including every foot, antenna and stinger inside margins. Remove rocks, dirt and outdoor scenery; empty shared charcoal backdrop and a short contact shadow.
